If interpreterBackend = "BOTH" Then
        If astStatus <> "PASS" Or mirStatus <> "PASS" Then
            UXBLayerEventEnd "INTERPRETER", "fail", "AST/MIR interpreter comparison prerequisite failed"
            UxbTraceEnd "EXECMEM", "FAIL", "AST/MIR interpreter comparison prerequisite failed"
            UxbError "AST/MIR interpreter BOTH modu basarisiz: AST=" & astStatus & " MIR=" & mirStatus
            End 25
        End If
    End If

    If interpreterBackend = "MIR" And mirOutput <> "" Then Print mirOutput;

    Dim executionSuccessMessage As String
    executionSuccessMessage = UXBMessageText("UXB_EXECUTION_SUCCEEDED", "Bellek yurutme basarili", "Execution completed successfully")
    UxbInfo executionSuccessMessage
    UXBLayerEventEnd "INTERPRETER", "ok", "memory execution complete"
    UxbTraceEnd "EXECMEM", "OK", "memory execution complete"
End If

If interopMode Then
    UxbTraceBegin "INTEROP", "interop artifacts"
    UXBLayerEventBegin "IMPORT_RESOLVE", sourcePath
    Dim manifest As InteropManifest
    Dim interopErr As String

    If ResolveInteropManifestForSource(sourcePath, manifest, interopErr) = 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "IMPORT_RESOLVE", "UXB_IMPORT_RESOLVE_FAILED", interopErr
        UXBLayerEventEnd "IMPORT_RESOLVE", "fail", interopErr
        UxbError "Baglanti cozumleme basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(interopErr)
        End 3
    End If

    If EmitInteropArtifacts(manifest, outputContractPaths.buildRoot & "/interop/" & outputContractPaths.runId, interopErr) = 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "IMPORT_RESOLVE", "UXB_IMPORT_ARTIFACT_FAILED", interopErr
        UXBLayerEventEnd "IMPORT_RESOLVE", "fail", interopErr
        UxbError "Baglanti cikti yazimi basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(interopErr)
        End 4
    End If

    If FfiX64BackendEmitArtifacts(ps, outputContractPaths.buildRoot & "/interop/" & outputContractPaths.runId, interopErr) = 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "FFI_EMIT", "UXB_FFI_X64_EMIT_FAILED", interopErr
        UXBLayerEventEnd "FFI_EMIT", "fail", interopErr
        UxbError "FFI x64 codegen cikti yazimi basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(interopErr)
        End 4
    End If

    ' x86 backend retired: old x86 FFI artifact emitter is intentionally omitted here.
    ' The old x86 files live under src/retired/x86 and are not active build inputs.
    UxbTraceOutput "FFI_EMIT", "x86", "retired"

    If debugMode Then
        UxbInfo "Interop include sayisi: " & Str(manifest.includeCount)
        UxbInfo "Interop import sayisi: " & Str(manifest.importCount)
    End If
    UxbTraceOutput "INTEROP", "interop_dir", outputContractPaths.buildRoot & "/interop/" & outputContractPaths.runId
    UXBLayerEventEnd "IMPORT_RESOLVE", "ok", "interop artifacts emitted"
    UXBLayerEventEnd "FFI_EMIT", "ok", "interop backend artifacts emitted"
    UxbTraceEnd "INTEROP", "OK", "interop artifacts emitted"
End If

If x64EmitMode Then
    UxbTraceBegin "X64_EMIT", x64OutPath
    UXBLayerEventBegin IIf(x64PolicyId = UXB_X64_POLICY_MIR, "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "X64_AST_CODEGEN"), x64OutPath
    Dim asmText As String
    Dim codegenErr As String

    If x64BothMode <> 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventBegin "X64_AST_CODEGEN", x64AstOutPath
        If GenerateX64Code(ps, asmText, codegenErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "UXB_X64_AST_EMIT_FAILED", codegenErr
            UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "fail", codegenErr
            UxbError "x64 AST NASM codegen basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(codegenErr)
            UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "FAIL", codegenErr
            End 6
        End If
        If SaveTextFile(x64AstOutPath, asmText) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "UXB_X64_AST_WRITE_FAILED", "write failed: " & x64AstOutPath
            UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "fail", "write failed: " & x64AstOutPath
            UxbError "x64 AST NASM cikti dosyasi yazilamadi: " & x64AstOutPath
            UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "FAIL", "write failed: " & x64AstOutPath
            End 7
        End If
        Dim x64AstReportErr As String
        If UXBX64WriteAsmRouteReport(outputContractPaths.x64AstReportJsonOutPath, "X64_AST", x64AstOutPath, "PASS", "", x64AstReportErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "UXB_X64_AST_REPORT_WRITE_FAILED", x64AstReportErr
            UxbError "x64 AST raporu yazilamadi: " & x64AstReportErr
            End 7
        End If

        If MIRX64EmitModule(mirModule, x64MirOutPath, codegenErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "UXB_MIR_X64_EMIT_FAILED", codegenErr
            UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "fail", codegenErr
            UxbError "MIR x64 NASM codegen basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(codegenErr)
            UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "FAIL", codegenErr
            End 6
        End If
        Dim x64MirReportErr As String
        If UXBX64WriteAsmRouteReport(outputContractPaths.x64MirReportJsonOutPath, "X64_MIR", x64MirOutPath, "PASS", "", x64MirReportErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "UXB_MIR_X64_REPORT_WRITE_FAILED", x64MirReportErr
            UxbError "x64 MIR raporu yazilamadi: " & x64MirReportErr
            End 7
        End If

        Dim x64CompareReportPath As String
        Dim x64CompareStatus As String
        Dim x64CompareErr As String
        x64CompareReportPath = outputContractPaths.artifactRoot & "/backend/x64_compare/report.json"
        UXBLayerEventBegin "X64_COMPARE", x64CompareReportPath
        If UXBX64CompareAsmFiles(x64AstOutPath, x64MirOutPath, x64CompareReportPath, x64CompareStatus, x64CompareErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "X64_COMPARE", "UXB_X64_AST_MIR_COMPARE_FAILED", x64CompareErr
            UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_COMPARE", "fail", x64CompareErr
            UxbError "x64 AST/MIR compare raporu yazilamadi: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(x64CompareErr)
            UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "FAIL", x64CompareErr
            End 26
        End If
        If x64CompareStatus <> "PASS" Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "X64_COMPARE", "UXB_X64_AST_MIR_ASM_DIFF", x64CompareErr
        End If
        UxbTraceOutput "X64_EMIT", "x64_compare_report", x64CompareReportPath
        If x64CompareStatus = "PASS" Then
            UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_COMPARE", "ok", "AST/MIR asm exact match"
        Else
            UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_COMPARE", "warn", x64CompareErr
        End If

        UxbInfo "x64 AST NASM cikti yazildi: " & x64AstOutPath
        UxbInfo "x64 MIR NASM cikti yazildi: " & x64MirOutPath
        UxbTraceOutput "X64_EMIT", "x64_ast_asm", x64AstOutPath
        UxbTraceOutput "X64_EMIT", "x64_mir_asm", x64MirOutPath
        UXBLayerEventEnd "X64_AST_CODEGEN", "ok", "ast asm emitted"
        UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "ok", "mir asm emitted"
        UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "OK", "ast+mir asm emitted"
    Else
    ' Route emit-only NASM generation through the same direct path used by
    ' --codegen so emit/build stay on one proven code path.
    If codegenSourceMode = "MIR" Then
        If x64PolicyId = UXB_X64_POLICY_MIR Then
            UxbInfo "Codegen route: MIR verified -> MIR emitter"
        Else
            UxbInfo "Codegen route: MIR verified -> AST emitter"
        End If
    End If
    If x64PolicyId = UXB_X64_POLICY_MIR Then
        If MIRX64EmitModule(mirModule, x64OutPath, codegenErr) = 0 Then
            UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "UXB_MIR_X64_EMIT_FAILED", codegenErr
            UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_X64_CODEGEN", "fail", codegenErr
            UxbError "MIR x64 NASM codegen basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(codegenErr)
            UxbTraceEnd "X64_EMIT", "FAIL", codegenErr
            End 6
        End If

Function X64BuildEmitArtifactsFromAsm(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef sourcePath As String, ByRef outputDir As String, ByRef compilerAsmText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim defaultExeName As String
    defaultExeName = "program.exe"
    Return X64BuildEmitArtifactsCore(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, defaultExeName, 1, compilerAsmText, errText)
End Function

Private Function X64BuildRunArtifactsCore(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef sourcePath As String, ByRef outputDir As String, ByRef exeFileName As String, ByVal useProvidedAsm As Integer, ByRef providedAsmText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim outDir As String
    outDir = outputDir
    If Trim(outDir) = "" Then outDir = "build\manual\exe\x64build"

    Dim lockAcquired As Integer
    lockAcquired = 0
    If X64BuildAcquireGlobalSlot(sourcePath, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    lockAcquired = 1

    Dim ok As Integer
    ok = 0
    Dim cmdText As String
    Dim shellResult As Integer
    ' X64_BUILD_LOG_CAPTURE_GOTO_SAFE_FIX_20260712:
    ' FreeBASIC forbids a branch from crossing a local var-len String definition.
    ' Declare these strings before the first GoTo that targets the cleanup label.
    Dim buildStdoutPath As String
    Dim buildStderrPath As String

    If X64BuildEmitArtifactsCore(ps, sourcePath, outDir, exeFileName, useProvidedAsm, providedAsmText, errText) = 0 Then GoTo X64BuildRunArtifactsCleanup

    ' X64_BUILD_LOG_CAPTURE_FIX_20260712:
    ' Shell() hides child batch stdout/stderr from the compiler.  Capture them next
    ' to the x64 artifact directory so ABI10/release diagnostics expose the real
    ' NASM/GCC/linker failure instead of just "uxb.exe : NativeCommandError".
    buildStdoutPath = PathNormalize(outDir & "\build_all.stdout.txt")
    buildStderrPath = PathNormalize(outDir & "\build_all.stderr.txt")
    cmdText = "cmd /c " & Chr(34) & Chr(34) & PathNormalize(outDir & "\build_all.bat") & Chr(34) & " > " & Chr(34) & buildStdoutPath & Chr(34) & " 2> " & Chr(34) & buildStderrPath & Chr(34) & Chr(34)
    shellResult = Shell(cmdText)
    If shellResult <> 0 Then
        errText = "x64-build: build_all.bat failed with exit code " & LTrim(Str(shellResult)) & " stdout=" & buildStdoutPath & " stderr=" & buildStderrPath
        GoTo X64BuildRunArtifactsCleanup
    End If

    If FileExistsPath(outDir & "\obj\program.obj") = 0 Then
        errText = "x64-build: NASM reported success but object artifact is missing: " & outDir & "\obj\program.obj"
        GoTo X64BuildRunArtifactsCleanup
    End If
    If FileExistsPath(outDir & "\" & exeFileName) = 0 Then
        errText = "x64-build: linker reported success but executable artifact is missing: " & outDir & "\" & exeFileName
        GoTo X64BuildRunArtifactsCleanup
    End If

    ok = 1

X64BuildRunArtifactsCleanup:
    If lockAcquired <> 0 Then X64BuildReleaseGlobalSlot
    If ok = 0 Then Return 0
    Return 1
End Function

Function X64BuildRunArtifacts(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef sourcePath As String, ByRef outputDir As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim noAsmOverride As String
    noAsmOverride = ""
    Dim defaultExeName As String
    defaultExeName = "program.exe"
    Return X64BuildRunArtifactsCore(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, defaultExeName, 0, noAsmOverride, errText)

# S-025: timeout-bounded process runner used by the compiler's --x64-mode BOTH
# real-execution comparison (backend_x64_real_execution_compare.fbs). Runs one
# built executable with stdin closed (never blocks waiting for input), captures
# stdout/stderr to files, and kills it if it runs past the timeout instead of
# hanging the compiler on a user program with an infinite loop.
#
# Exit code: the child process's own exit code, or 124 on timeout (matches the
# conventional GNU coreutils `timeout` sentinel).
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ExePath,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$StdoutPath,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$StderrPath,
    [int]$TimeoutMs = 10000
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
$psi.FileName = $ExePath
$psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
$psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
$psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true
$psi.UseShellExecute = $false
$psi.CreateNoWindow = $true

$proc = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
$proc.StandardInput.Close()
$stdoutTask = $proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
$stderrTask = $proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()

$finished = $proc.WaitForExit($TimeoutMs)

if (-not $finished) {
    try { $proc.Kill($true) } catch {}
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
    $partialOut = ""
    $partialErr = ""
    try { if ($stdoutTask.Wait(500)) { $partialOut = $stdoutTask.Result } } catch {}
    try { if ($stderrTask.Wait(500)) { $partialErr = $stderrTask.Result } } catch {}
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($StdoutPath, $partialOut)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($StderrPath, "TIMEOUT after ${TimeoutMs}ms`n" + $partialErr)
    exit 124
}

[IO.File]::WriteAllText($StdoutPath, $stdoutTask.Result)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($StderrPath, $stderrTask.Result)
exit $proc.ExitCode

#ifndef UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS
#define UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS

' S-025: `--x64-mode BOTH` used to call UXBX64CompareAsmFiles (backend_output_compare.fbs),
' which compares the two emitters' raw NASM TEXT for byte equality. AST-direct x64
' and MIR-x64 are structurally different emitters (different register allocation,
' different helper layout) that are never expected to produce identical assembly
' even when they are 100% behaviorally correct and agree on every observable
' result — so that comparison was guaranteed to report FAIL on real, healthy
' builds (audit evidence: ~37.9K vs ~5.2K normalized characters). This file
' replaces the pass/fail *gate* with the only invariant "BOTH" is actually meant
' to prove: the two routes' compiled, LINKED, EXECUTED programs produce the same
' observable output. It builds both routes into separate directories, runs both
' real .exe files (through a timeout-bounded PowerShell runner so a user
' program's infinite loop cannot hang the compiler), and compares normalized
' stdout plus exit code. The raw assembly text is still emitted and still
' reported (as non-gating diagnostic info) so nothing that was visible before is
' lost.

#include once "backend_output_compare.fbs"
#include once "../../build/x64_build_pipeline.fbs"

Type UXBX64RouteRunResult
    buildOk As Integer
    runOk As Integer
    exePath As String
    stdoutText As String
    stderrText As String
    exitCode As Integer
    errorText As String
End Type

Private Function UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath() As String
    Return "tools\x64_compare\run_with_timeout.ps1"
End Function

' Runs one already-built executable with a timeout, capturing stdout/stderr and
' the process exit code. Never blocks on stdin (the script closes it immediately),
' so a program that reads INPUT just sees EOF instead of hanging the comparison.
Function UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput( _
    ByRef exePath As String, _
    ByRef workDir As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef stdoutTextOut As String, _
    ByRef stderrTextOut As String, _
    ByRef exitCodeOut As Integer, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    stdoutTextOut = ""
    stderrTextOut = ""
    exitCodeOut = -1
    errText = ""

    If Dir(exePath) = "" Then
        errText = "executable not found: " & exePath
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim scriptPath As String
    scriptPath = UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath()
    If Dir(scriptPath) = "" Then
        errText = "x64 compare runner script not found: " & scriptPath
        Return 0
    End If

    UXBBackendCompareEnsureDir workDir & "\marker.txt"
    Dim stdoutPath As String
    Dim stderrPath As String
    stdoutPath = workDir & "\exec_stdout.txt"
    stderrPath = workDir & "\exec_stderr.txt"

    Dim cmdText As String
    cmdText = "cmd /c " & Chr(34) & "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File " & Chr(34) & scriptPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -ExePath " & Chr(34) & exePath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StdoutPath " & Chr(34) & stdoutPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StderrPath " & Chr(34) & stderrPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -TimeoutMs " & LTrim(Str(timeoutMs)) & Chr(34)
    exitCodeOut = Shell(cmdText)

    Dim loadErr As String
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stdoutPath, stdoutTextOut, loadErr
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stderrPath, stderrTextOut, loadErr

    If exitCodeOut = 124 Then
        errText = "execution timed out: " & exePath
        Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds one route (AST-direct x64 or MIR-x64, selected by which NASM text the
' caller passes in) into its own directory, then runs the resulting exe.
Function UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef outputDir As String, _
    ByRef asmText As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef result As UXBX64RouteRunResult _
) As Integer
    result.buildOk = 0
    result.runOk = 0
    result.exePath = outputDir & "\program.exe"
    result.stdoutText = ""
    result.stderrText = ""
    result.exitCode = -1
    result.errorText = ""

    Dim buildErr As String
    If X64BuildRunArtifactsFromAsmNamed(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, "program.exe", asmText, buildErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "build failed: " & buildErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.buildOk = 1

    Dim runErr As String
    If UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput(result.exePath, outputDir, timeoutMs, result.stdoutText, result.stderrText, result.exitCode, runErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "run failed: " & runErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.runOk = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBX64CompareRealExecution( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmText As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmText As String, _
    ByRef compareRootDir As String, _
    ByRef reportPath As String, _
    ByRef compareStatusOut As String, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    compareStatusOut = "UNKNOWN"
    errText = ""

    Dim astResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim mirResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim timeoutMs As Integer
    timeoutMs = 10000

    Dim astErr As String
    Dim astOk As Integer
    astOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\ast_exe", astAsmText, timeoutMs, astResult)

    Dim mirOk As Integer
    mirOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\mir_exe", mirAsmText, timeoutMs, mirResult)

    Dim stdoutMatch As Integer
    Dim exitCodeMatch As Integer
    stdoutMatch = 0
    exitCodeMatch = 0
    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 Then
        stdoutMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astResult.stdoutText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirResult.stdoutText), 1, 0)
        exitCodeMatch = IIf(astResult.exitCode = mirResult.exitCode, 1, 0)
    End If

    ' Raw assembly text is still diffed and reported, but only as non-gating
    ' diagnostic context (see file header) -- structurally different emitters
    ' are never expected to match here even when both are correct.
    Dim asmTextMatch As Integer
    asmTextMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astAsmText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirAsmText), 1, 0)

    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And stdoutMatch <> 0 And exitCodeMatch <> 0 Then
        compareStatusOut = "PASS"
    Else
        compareStatusOut = "FAIL"
        If astOk = 0 Then errText = "AST route: " & astResult.errorText
        If mirOk = 0 Then errText = IIf(errText <> "", errText & " | ", "") & "MIR route: " & mirResult.errorText
        If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And errText = "" Then
            errText = "observable output differs: stdout_match=" & LTrim(Str(stdoutMatch)) & " exit_code_match=" & LTrim(Str(exitCodeMatch)) & _
                " (ast_exit=" & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & " mir_exit=" & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & ")"
        End If
    End If

    Dim q As String
    q = Chr(34)
    Dim j As String
    j = "{" & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "schema_version" & q & ": " & q & "uxb.x64_ast_mir_compare.v2" & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "kind" & q & ": " & q & "x64_ast_vs_x64_mir_real_execution_compare" & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "status" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(compareStatusOut) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_asm_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astAsmPath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_asm_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirAsmPath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_exe_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astResult.exePath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_exe_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirResult.exePath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_build_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(astResult.buildOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_build_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(mirResult.buildOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_run_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(astResult.runOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_run_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(mirResult.runOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_exit_code" & q & ": " & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_exit_code" & q & ": " & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "exit_code_match" & q & ": " & IIf(exitCodeMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "stdout_match" & q & ": " & IIf(stdoutMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_stdout" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astResult.stdoutText) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_stdout" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirResult.stdoutText) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "asm_text_match_informational_only" & q & ": " & IIf(asmTextMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "diagnostic" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(errText) & q & Chr(10)
    j &= "}" & Chr(10)

    Dim writeErr As String
    If UXBBackendCompareWriteText(reportPath, j, writeErr) = 0 Then
        errText = writeErr
        compareStatusOut = "ERROR"
        Return 0
    End If

    If compareStatusOut = "ERROR" Then Return 0
    Return 1
End Function

#endif

        " -StdoutPath " & Chr(34) & stdoutPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StderrPath " & Chr(34) & stderrPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -TimeoutMs " & LTrim(Str(timeoutMs)) & Chr(34)
    exitCodeOut = Shell(cmdText)

    Dim loadErr As String
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stdoutPath, stdoutTextOut, loadErr
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stderrPath, stderrTextOut, loadErr

    If exitCodeOut = 124 Then
        errText = "execution timed out: " & exePath
        Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds one route (AST-direct x64 or MIR-x64, selected by which NASM text the
' caller passes in) into its own directory, then runs the resulting exe.
Function UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef outputDir As String, _
    ByRef asmText As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef result As UXBX64RouteRunResult _
) As Integer
    result.buildOk = 0
    result.runOk = 0
    result.exePath = outputDir & "\program.exe"
    result.stdoutText = ""
    result.stderrText = ""
    result.exitCode = -1
    result.errorText = ""

    Dim buildErr As String
    If X64BuildRunArtifactsFromAsmNamed(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, "program.exe", asmText, buildErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "build failed: " & buildErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.buildOk = 1

    Dim runErr As String
    If UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput(result.exePath, outputDir, timeoutMs, result.stdoutText, result.stderrText, result.exitCode, runErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "run failed: " & runErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.runOk = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBX64CompareRealExecution( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmText As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmText As String, _
    ByRef compareRootDir As String, _
    ByRef reportPath As String, _
    ByRef compareStatusOut As String, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    compareStatusOut = "UNKNOWN"
    errText = ""

    Dim astResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim mirResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim timeoutMs As Integer
    timeoutMs = 10000

    Dim astErr As String
    Dim astOk As Integer
    astOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\ast_exe", astAsmText, timeoutMs, astResult)

    Dim mirOk As Integer
    mirOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\mir_exe", mirAsmText, timeoutMs, mirResult)

    Dim stdoutMatch As Integer
    Dim exitCodeMatch As Integer
    stdoutMatch = 0
    exitCodeMatch = 0
    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 Then
        stdoutMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astResult.stdoutText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirResult.stdoutText), 1, 0)
        exitCodeMatch = IIf(astResult.exitCode = mirResult.exitCode, 1, 0)
    End If

    ' Raw assembly text is still diffed and reported, but only as non-gating
    ' diagnostic context (see file header) -- structurally different emitters
    ' are never expected to match here even when both are correct.
    Dim asmTextMatch As Integer
    asmTextMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astAsmText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirAsmText), 1, 0)

    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And stdoutMatch <> 0 And exitCodeMatch <> 0 Then
        compareStatusOut = "PASS"
    Else
        compareStatusOut = "FAIL"
        If astOk = 0 Then errText = "AST route: " & astResult.errorText
        If mirOk = 0 Then errText = IIf(errText <> "", errText & " | ", "") & "MIR route: " & mirResult.errorText
        If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And errText = "" Then
            errText = "observable output differs: stdout_match=" & LTrim(Str(stdoutMatch)) & " exit_code_match=" & LTrim(Str(exitCodeMatch)) & _
                " (ast_exit=" & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & " mir_exit=" & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & ")"
        End If
    End If

    Dim q As String
    q = Chr(34)
    Dim j As String
    j = "{" & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "schema_version" & q & ": " & q & "uxb.x64_ast_mir_compare.v2" & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "kind" & q & ": " & q & "x64_ast_vs_x64_mir_real_execution_compare" & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "status" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(compareStatusOut) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_asm_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astAsmPath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_asm_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirAsmPath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_exe_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astResult.exePath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_exe_path" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirResult.exePath) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_build_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(astResult.buildOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_build_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(mirResult.buildOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_run_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(astResult.runOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_run_ok" & q & ": " & IIf(mirResult.runOk <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_exit_code" & q & ": " & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_exit_code" & q & ": " & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "exit_code_match" & q & ": " & IIf(exitCodeMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "stdout_match" & q & ": " & IIf(stdoutMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "ast_stdout" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(astResult.stdoutText) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "mir_stdout" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(mirResult.stdoutText) & q & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "asm_text_match_informational_only" & q & ": " & IIf(asmTextMatch <> 0, "true", "false") & "," & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "diagnostic" & q & ": " & q & UXBBackendCompareJsonEscape(errText) & q & Chr(10)
    j &= "}" & Chr(10)

    Dim writeErr As String
    If UXBBackendCompareWriteText(reportPath, j, writeErr) = 0 Then
        errText = writeErr
        compareStatusOut = "ERROR"
        Return 0
    End If

    If compareStatusOut = "ERROR" Then Return 0
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput( _
    ByRef exePath As String, _
    ByRef workDir As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef stdoutTextOut As String, _
    ByRef stderrTextOut As String, _
    ByRef exitCodeOut As Integer, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    stdoutTextOut = ""
    stderrTextOut = ""
    exitCodeOut = -1
    errText = ""

    If Dir(exePath) = "" Then
        errText = "executable not found: " & exePath
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim scriptPath As String
    scriptPath = UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath()
    If Dir(scriptPath) = "" Then
        errText = "x64 compare runner script not found: " & scriptPath
        Return 0
    End If

    UXBBackendCompareEnsureDir workDir & "\marker.txt"
    Dim stdoutPath As String
    Dim stderrPath As String
    stdoutPath = workDir & "\exec_stdout.txt"
    stderrPath = workDir & "\exec_stderr.txt"

    Dim cmdText As String
    cmdText = "cmd /c " & Chr(34) & "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File " & Chr(34) & scriptPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -ExePath " & Chr(34) & exePath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StdoutPath " & Chr(34) & stdoutPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StderrPath " & Chr(34) & stderrPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -TimeoutMs " & LTrim(Str(timeoutMs)) & Chr(34)
    exitCodeOut = Shell(cmdText)

    Dim loadErr As String
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stdoutPath, stdoutTextOut, loadErr
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stderrPath, stderrTextOut, loadErr

    If exitCodeOut = 124 Then
        errText = "execution timed out: " & exePath
        Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds one route (AST-direct x64 or MIR-x64, selected by which NASM text the
' caller passes in) into its own directory, then runs the resulting exe.
Function UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef outputDir As String, _
    ByRef asmText As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef result As UXBX64RouteRunResult _
) As Integer
    result.buildOk = 0
    result.runOk = 0
    result.exePath = outputDir & "\program.exe"
    result.stdoutText = ""
    result.stderrText = ""
    result.exitCode = -1
    result.errorText = ""

    Dim buildErr As String
    If X64BuildRunArtifactsFromAsmNamed(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, "program.exe", asmText, buildErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "build failed: " & buildErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.buildOk = 1

#ifndef UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS
#define UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS

' S-025: `--x64-mode BOTH` used to call UXBX64CompareAsmFiles (backend_output_compare.fbs),
' which compares the two emitters' raw NASM TEXT for byte equality. AST-direct x64
' and MIR-x64 are structurally different emitters (different register allocation,
' different helper layout) that are never expected to produce identical assembly
' even when they are 100% behaviorally correct and agree on every observable
' result — so that comparison was guaranteed to report FAIL on real, healthy
' builds (audit evidence: ~37.9K vs ~5.2K normalized characters). This file
' replaces the pass/fail *gate* with the only invariant "BOTH" is actually meant
' to prove: the two routes' compiled, LINKED, EXECUTED programs produce the same
' observable output. It builds both routes into separate directories, runs both
' real .exe files (through a timeout-bounded PowerShell runner so a user
' program's infinite loop cannot hang the compiler), and compares normalized
' stdout plus exit code. The raw assembly text is still emitted and still
' reported (as non-gating diagnostic info) so nothing that was visible before is
' lost.

#include once "backend_output_compare.fbs"
#include once "../../build/x64_build_pipeline.fbs"

Type UXBX64RouteRunResult
    buildOk As Integer
    runOk As Integer
    exeFilePathArg As String
    stdoutText As String
    stderrText As String
    exitCode As Integer
    errorText As String
End Type

Private Function UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath() As String
    Return "tools\x64_compare\run_with_timeout.ps1"
End Function

' Runs one already-built executable with a timeout, capturing stdout/stderr and
' the process exit code. Never blocks on stdin (the script closes it immediately),
' so a program that reads INPUT just sees EOF instead of hanging the comparison.
Function UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput( _
    ByRef exeFilePathArg As String, _
    ByRef workDir As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef stdoutTextOut As String, _
    ByRef stderrTextOut As String, _
    ByRef exitCodeOut As Integer, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    stdoutTextOut = ""
    stderrTextOut = ""
    exitCodeOut = -1
    errText = ""

    If Dir(exeFilePathArg) = "" Then
        errText = "executable not found: " & exeFilePathArg
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim scriptPath As String
    scriptPath = UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath()
    If Dir(scriptPath) = "" Then
        errText = "x64 compare runner script not found: " & scriptPath
        Return 0
    End If

    UXBBackendCompareEnsureDir workDir & "\marker.txt"
    Dim stdoutPath As String
    Dim stderrPath As String
    stdoutPath = workDir & "\exec_stdout.txt"
    stderrPath = workDir & "\exec_stderr.txt"

    Dim cmdText As String
    cmdText = "cmd /c " & Chr(34) & "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File " & Chr(34) & scriptPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -exeFilePathArg " & Chr(34) & exeFilePathArg & Chr(34) & _
        " -StdoutPath " & Chr(34) & stdoutPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StderrPath " & Chr(34) & stderrPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -TimeoutMs " & LTrim(Str(timeoutMs)) & Chr(34)
    exitCodeOut = Shell(cmdText)

    Dim loadErr As String
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stdoutPath, stdoutTextOut, loadErr
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stderrPath, stderrTextOut, loadErr

    If exitCodeOut = 124 Then
        errText = "execution timed out: " & exeFilePathArg
        Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds one route (AST-direct x64 or MIR-x64, selected by which NASM text the
' caller passes in) into its own directory, then runs the resulting exe.
Function UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef outputDir As String, _
    ByRef asmText As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef result As UXBX64RouteRunResult _
) As Integer
    result.buildOk = 0
    result.runOk = 0
    result.exeFilePathArg = outputDir & "\program.exe"
    result.stdoutText = ""
    result.stderrText = ""
    result.exitCode = -1
    result.errorText = ""

    Dim buildErr As String
    If X64BuildRunArtifactsFromAsmNamed(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, "program.exe", asmText, buildErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "build failed: " & buildErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.buildOk = 1

    Dim runErr As String
    If UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput(result.exeFilePathArg, outputDir, timeoutMs, result.stdoutText, result.stderrText, result.exitCode, runErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "run failed: " & runErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.runOk = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBX64CompareRealExecution( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmText As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmText As String, _
    ByRef compareRootDir As String, _
    ByRef reportPath As String, _
    ByRef compareStatusOut As String, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    compareStatusOut = "UNKNOWN"
    errText = ""

    Dim astResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim mirResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim timeoutMs As Integer
    timeoutMs = 10000

    Dim astErr As String
    Dim astOk As Integer
    astOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\ast_exe", astAsmText, timeoutMs, astResult)

    Dim mirOk As Integer
    mirOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\mir_exe", mirAsmText, timeoutMs, mirResult)

    Dim stdoutMatch As Integer
    Dim exitCodeMatch As Integer
    stdoutMatch = 0
    exitCodeMatch = 0
    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 Then
        stdoutMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astResult.stdoutText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirResult.stdoutText), 1, 0)
        exitCodeMatch = IIf(astResult.exitCode = mirResult.exitCode, 1, 0)
    End If

    ' Raw assembly text is still diffed and reported, but only as non-gating
    ' diagnostic context (see file header) -- structurally different emitters
    ' are never expected to match here even when both are correct.
    Dim asmTextMatch As Integer
    asmTextMatch = IIf(UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(astAsmText) = UXBBackendNormalizeOutput(mirAsmText), 1, 0)

    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And stdoutMatch <> 0 And exitCodeMatch <> 0 Then
        compareStatusOut = "PASS"
    Else
        compareStatusOut = "FAIL"
        If astOk = 0 Then errText = "AST route: " & astResult.errorText
        If mirOk = 0 Then errText = IIf(errText <> "", errText & " | ", "") & "MIR route: " & mirResult.errorText
        If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And errText = "" Then
            errText = "observable output differs: stdout_match=" & LTrim(Str(stdoutMatch)) & " exit_code_match=" & LTrim(Str(exitCodeMatch)) & _
                " (ast_exit=" & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & " mir_exit=" & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & ")"
        End If
    End If

    Dim q As String
    q = Chr(34)
    Dim j As String
    j = "{" & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "schema_version" & q & ": " & q & "uxb.x64_ast_mir_compare.v2" & q & "," & Chr(10)

#ifndef UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS
#define UXB_BACKEND_X64_REAL_EXECUTION_COMPARE_FBS

' S-025: `--x64-mode BOTH` used to call UXBX64CompareAsmFiles (backend_output_compare.fbs),
' which compares the two emitters' raw NASM TEXT for byte equality. AST-direct x64
' and MIR-x64 are structurally different emitters (different register allocation,
' different helper layout) that are never expected to produce identical assembly
' even when they are 100% behaviorally correct and agree on every observable
' result — so that comparison was guaranteed to report FAIL on real, healthy
' builds (audit evidence: ~37.9K vs ~5.2K normalized characters). This file
' replaces the pass/fail *gate* with the only invariant "BOTH" is actually meant
' to prove: the two routes' compiled, LINKED, EXECUTED programs produce the same
' observable output. It builds both routes into separate directories, runs both
' real .exe files (through a timeout-bounded PowerShell runner so a user
' program's infinite loop cannot hang the compiler), and compares normalized
' stdout plus exit code. The raw assembly text is still emitted and still
' reported (as non-gating diagnostic info) so nothing that was visible before is
' lost.

#include once "backend_output_compare.fbs"
#include once "../../build/x64_build_pipeline.fbs"

Type UXBX64RouteRunResult
    buildOk As Integer
    runOk As Integer
    exeFilePathArg As String
    stdoutText As String
    stderrText As String
    exitCode As Integer
    errorText As String
End Type

Private Function UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath() As String
    Return "tools\x64_compare\run_with_timeout.ps1"
End Function

' Runs one already-built executable with a timeout, capturing stdout/stderr and
' the process exit code. Never blocks on stdin (the script closes it immediately),
' so a program that reads INPUT just sees EOF instead of hanging the comparison.
Function UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput( _
    ByRef exeFilePathArg As String, _
    ByRef workDir As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef stdoutTextOut As String, _
    ByRef stderrTextOut As String, _
    ByRef exitCodeOut As Integer, _
    ByRef errText As String _
) As Integer
    stdoutTextOut = ""
    stderrTextOut = ""
    exitCodeOut = -1
    errText = ""

    If Dir(exeFilePathArg) = "" Then
        errText = "executable not found: " & exeFilePathArg
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim scriptPath As String
    scriptPath = UXBX64ComparePsScriptPath()
    If Dir(scriptPath) = "" Then
        errText = "x64 compare runner script not found: " & scriptPath
        Return 0
    End If

    UXBBackendCompareEnsureDir workDir & "\marker.txt"
    Dim stdoutPath As String
    Dim stderrPath As String
    stdoutPath = workDir & "\exec_stdout.txt"
    stderrPath = workDir & "\exec_stderr.txt"

    Dim cmdText As String
    cmdText = "cmd /c " & Chr(34) & "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File " & Chr(34) & scriptPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -exeFilePathArg " & Chr(34) & exeFilePathArg & Chr(34) & _
        " -StdoutPath " & Chr(34) & stdoutPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -StderrPath " & Chr(34) & stderrPath & Chr(34) & _
        " -TimeoutMs " & LTrim(Str(timeoutMs)) & Chr(34)
    exitCodeOut = Shell(cmdText)

    Dim loadErr As String
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stdoutPath, stdoutTextOut, loadErr
    UXBBackendCompareLoadText stderrPath, stderrTextOut, loadErr

    If exitCodeOut = 124 Then
        errText = "execution timed out: " & exeFilePathArg
        Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds one route (AST-direct x64 or MIR-x64, selected by which NASM text the
' caller passes in) into its own directory, then runs the resulting exe.
Function UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef outputDir As String, _
    ByRef asmText As String, _
    ByVal timeoutMs As Integer, _
    ByRef result As UXBX64RouteRunResult _
) As Integer
    result.buildOk = 0
    result.runOk = 0
    result.exeFilePathArg = outputDir & "\program.exe"
    result.stdoutText = ""
    result.stderrText = ""
    result.exitCode = -1
    result.errorText = ""

    Dim buildErr As String
    If X64BuildRunArtifactsFromAsmNamed(ps, sourcePath, outputDir, "program.exe", asmText, buildErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "build failed: " & buildErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.buildOk = 1

    Dim runErr As String
    If UXBX64RunExeCaptureOutput(result.exeFilePathArg, outputDir, timeoutMs, result.stdoutText, result.stderrText, result.exitCode, runErr) = 0 Then
        result.errorText = "run failed: " & runErr
        Return 0
    End If
    result.runOk = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBX64CompareRealExecution( _
    ByRef ps As ParseState, _
    ByRef sourcePath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef astAsmText As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmPath As String, _
    ByRef mirAsmText As String, _

    errText = ""

    Dim astResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult
    Dim mirResult As UXBX64RouteRunResult

    timeoutMs = 10000

    Dim astErr As String
    Dim astOk As Integer
    astOk = UXBX64BuildAndRunRoute(ps, sourcePath, compareRootDir & "\ast_exe", astAsmText, timeoutMs, astResult)

    If astOk <> 0 And mirOk <> 0 And stdoutMatch <> 0 And exitCodeMatch <> 0 Then
        compareStatusOut = "PASS"
    Else
        compareStatusOut = "FAIL"
        If astOk = 0 Then errText = "AST route: " & astResult.errorText
        If mirOk = 0 Then errText = IIf(errText <> "", errText & " | ", "") & "MIR route: " & mirResult.errorText

                " (ast_exit=" & LTrim(Str(astResult.exitCode)) & " mir_exit=" & LTrim(Str(mirResult.exitCode)) & ")"
        End If
    End If

    Dim q As String
    q = Chr(34)
    Dim j As String
    j = "{" & Chr(10)
    j &= "  " & q & "schema_version" & q & ": " & q & "uxb.x64_ast_mir_compare.v2" & q & "," & Chr(10)

Assembly-metni karşılaştırması (`UXBX64CompareAsmFiles`) hâlâ var ve hâlâ
`--emit-x64-nasm --x64-mode BOTH` (yalnız metin üretimi, build yok, hızlı, araç
bağımlılığı yok) yolunda kullanılıyor — kasıtlı olarak dokunulmadı, çünkü onu
gerçek build+run'a çevirmek önceden hızlı/bağımlılıksız olan bu komuta yeni bir
araç zinciri (NASM+linker+PowerShell) bağımlılığı ve gözle görülür süre
ekleyecekti. Asıl kapsayıcı düzeltme **`bld --x64-mode BOTH`** içindir — bu yol
önceden BOTH'u tamamen yok sayıp sessizce yalnız MIR-x64 rotasını
inşa ediyordu (karşılaştırma denemesi bile yoktu). Şimdi:
1. Birincil (MIR-x64) build öncekiyle birebir aynı şekilde yapılır ve tek
   `--build-x64-out` çıktısı olarak kalır (davranış değişmedi).
2. İkinci (AST-direct) rota ayrı bir dizine (`<build_dir>/both_compare/ast_exe/`)
   inşa edilir, MIR rotası da ayrı bir kopyaya (`.../mir_exe/`) inşa edilir.
3. **İkisi de gerçekten çalıştırılır** — yeni `tools/x64_compare/run_with_timeout.ps1`
   üzerinden: stdin kapalı (INPUT bekleyip asla takılmaz), stdout/stderr
   yakalanır, **10 saniyelik zaman aşımı** var (kullanıcının sonsuz döngülü
   programı derleyiciyi asla sonsuza kadar askıda bırakamaz — `taskkill /T /F`
   ile süreç ağacı öldürülür; ilk denemede `.Kill($true)` .NET Core-only
   overload'u Windows PowerShell 5.1'de sessizce hiçbir şey yapmadan
   çöktüğü için gerçek bir "hayalet süreç" hatası bulundu ve `taskkill`e
   çevrildi — bkz. kanıt altta).
4. Gerçek gözlemlenebilir sonuç (satır-sonu normalize edilmiş stdout + exit
   code) karşılaştırılır; `status` artık BUNA göre PASS/FAIL. Ham assembly
   metni hâlâ diff'lenip rapora yazılıyor ama `asm_text_match_informational_only`
   adıyla, kapıyı tıkamadan.
5. Uyuşmazlık (veya zaman aşımı) build'i **durdurmuyor** — kullanıcı yine de
   .exe'sini alır, yalnız net bir UYARI + tam JSON rapor yolu basılıyor
   (`--emit-x64-nasm` yolundaki mevcut "yalnız uyar" davranışıyla tutarlı).

**Doğrulama (taze host build + gerçek `bld --x64-mode BOTH` çalıştırma):**
- Normal program (`FOR i=1 TO 3: PRINT i`): `real_execution_report.json` →
  `status:PASS`, `ast_exit_code:0`, `mir_exit_code:0`, `exit_code_match:true`,
  `stdout_match:true`, `ast_stdout`/`mir_stdout` ikisi de `"1\n2\n3\n"`,
  `asm_text_match_informational_only:false` (beklenen — farklı emitter'lar,
  bilgi amaçlı, artık hataya sebep olmuyor). Konsola "AST ve MIR rotaları
  gercekten calistirildi, cikti birebir eslesti" basıldı, exit 0.
- **Sonsuz döngülü program** (`DO: i=i+1: LOOP`) ile uçtan uca test: derleyici
  **askıda kalmadı** — ~26 saniyede (2×10s zaman aşımı + build/başlatma
  yükü) tamamlandı, rapor her iki rotanın da `exit_code:124` (zaman aşımı)
  ile durduğunu gösterdi, build yine de `exit 0` ile bitti (yalnız uyarı),
  ve zaman aşımından sonra hiçbir yetim süreç kalmadığı doğrulandı
  (`Get-Process` boş döndü). İlk sürümde (`.Kill($true)`) süreç GERÇEKTEN
  ölmüyordu — bu, script `taskkill /T /F`e çevrilmeden önce yakalanıp
  düzeltilen gerçek bir bulguydu.
- Regresyon: normal (BOTH olmayan) `--x64-mode AST`/`--x64-mode MIR` build'leri
  değişmedi (gerçek EXE ile doğrulandı); emit-only `--x64-mode BOTH` hâlâ
  hızlı (~1.5s, build yok); `run_typed_task_tests.ps1` 33/33 PASS; Codex'in
  WAT testi ve native build probe'u (4/4) hâlâ PASS.

**Durum:** `YAPILDI-DOGRULANDI`.

## Durum raporu — kuyruk tamamen bitti

S-025 tam kapsamlı çözüldü ve gerçek testlerle doğrulandı. Özet:

**Ne yaptım:** `bld --x64-mode BOTH` komutu önceden "BOTH" adını taşımasına rağmen sadece tek bir rotayı (MIR-x64) inşa edip karşılaştırma bile denemiyordu. Şimdi gerçekten iki ayrı .exe inşa ediyor, **ikisini de gerçekten çalıştırıp** çıktılarını karşılaştırıyor — assembly metnini değil.

**Test sırasında kritik bir güvenlik hatası buldum ve düzelttim:** Sonsuz döngülü bir kullanıcı programı derleyiciyi sonsuza kadar askıda bırakabilirdi. Zaman aşımı korumasını yazdım, ilk denemede (`.Kill($true)`) sürecin **gerçekten ölmediğini** fark ettim (Windows PowerShell 5.1 uyumsuzluğu), `taskkill /T /F`'e çevirip yeniden test ettim — artık derleyici asla askıda kalmıyor, en fazla 20 saniye içinde net bir uyarıyla devam ediyor.

**Doğrulama:** Normal programda `status:PASS` + gerçek çıktı eşleşmesi; sonsuz döngülü programda derleyici askıda kalmadan temiz `FAIL` raporu; tüm mevcut regresyon testleri (33/33 + WAT + native-build) bozulmadan geçti; eski hızlı `--emit-x64-nasm` yolu bilerek dokunulmadan bırakıldı (yeni bağımlılık eklememek için).

**Codex'ten devraldığım tüm kuyruk (S-020, S-022, S-025, S-026, S-027, S-042) artık tamamen kapalı.**

Siz mesajınızda "iç belgelerde bir çok tasarım kararı alındı" dediniz — bu doğru, ve önemli: Claude 1 bu sabah 9 günlük tüm konuşmayı tarayıp **`docs/UXB_ACIK_ISLER_TASARIM_VE_UYGULAMA_PLANI_20260915_TR.md`** adında kapsamlı bir ana plan belgesi hazırlamış, S-051'den S-060'a kadar yeni sorunlar açılmış (bellek/VIRTUAL mimarisi, eşzamanlılık, JS BYREF hatası, OOP tasarımı vb.). #ifndef UXB_JS_EMITTER_FBS
#define UXB_JS_EMITTER_FBS

#include once "js_source_emit.fbs"
Private Const UXB_JS_FB_DIRECTORY_ATTR As Integer = 16

Private Function UXBJsEnsureDir(ByRef dirPath As String) As Integer
    Dim cleaned As String
    Dim part As String
    Dim current As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim ch As String

    cleaned = Trim(dirPath)
    If cleaned = "" Then Return 1

    current = ""
    part = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(cleaned)
        ch = Mid(cleaned, i, 1)
        If ch = "\" Or ch = "/" Then
            If part <> "" Then
                If current <> "" Then current &= "\"
                current &= part
                If Dir(current, UXB_JS_FB_DIRECTORY_ATTR) = "" Then MkDir current
                part = ""
            End If
        Else
            part &= ch
        End If
    Next i

    If part <> "" Then
        If current <> "" Then current &= "\"
        current &= part
        If Dir(current, UXB_JS_FB_DIRECTORY_ATTR) = "" Then MkDir current
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function UXBJsDirOf(ByRef filePath As String) As String
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = Len(filePath) To 1 Step -1
        If Mid(filePath, i, 1) = "\" Or Mid(filePath, i, 1) = "/" Then Return Left(filePath, i - 1)
    Next i
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function UXBJsWriteText(ByRef filePath As String, ByRef textValue As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ff As Integer
    UXBJsEnsureDir UXBJsDirOf(filePath)
    ff = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Output As #ff
    If Err <> 0 Then
        errText = "JS output file cannot be opened: " & filePath
        Return 0
    End If
    Print #ff, textValue;
    Close #ff
    Return 1
End Function

Private Function UXBJsCopyFileSafe(ByRef srcPath As String, ByRef dstPath As String) As Integer
    If Dir(srcPath) = "" Then Return 0
    UXBJsEnsureDir UXBJsDirOf(dstPath)
    If Dir(dstPath) <> "" Then Kill dstPath
    Dim fi As Integer, fo As Integer
    Dim dataText As String
    Dim dataLen As LongInt
    fi = FreeFile
    Open srcPath For Binary Access Read As #fi
    If Err <> 0 Then Return 0
    dataLen = LOF(fi)
    If dataLen > 0 Then
        dataText = Space(dataLen)
        Get #fi, 1, dataText
    Else
        dataText = ""
    End If
    Close #fi
    fo = FreeFile
    Open dstPath For Binary Access Write As #fo
    If Err <> 0 Then Return 0
    If dataLen > 0 Then Put #fo, 1, dataText
    Close #fo
    Return 1
End Function

Private Function UXBJsSelectEntryFunctionIndex(ByRef module As MIRModule) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    If module.functionCount <= 0 Then Return -1
    For i = 0 To module.functionCount - 1
        If LCase(Trim(module.functions(i).name)) = "main" Then Return i
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function UXBJsFunctionHasOwnBinding(ByRef fn As MIRFunction, ByRef nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String
    key = UCase(Trim(nameText))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To fn.paramVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(fn.paramVars(i))) = key Then Return 1
    Next i
    For i = 0 To fn.localVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(fn.localVars(i))) = key Then Return 1
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function UXBJsEmitFunction(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByRef fn As MIRFunction, ByRef outText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As Integer
    Dim j As Integer
    Dim blk As MIRBasicBlock
    Dim nextLabel As String
    Dim fnName As String
    Dim paramList As String
    Dim p As Integer

    fnName = UXBJsSafeIdentifier(Trim(fn.name))
    If fnName = "" Then fnName = "main"

    paramList = ""
    For p = 0 To fn.paramVarCount - 1
        If p > 0 Then paramList &= ", "
        paramList &= UXBJsSafeIdentifier(fn.paramVars(p))
    Next p

    outText &= "async function " & fnName & "(" & paramList & ") {" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "  const vars = Object.create(null);" & Chr(10)
    For p = 0 To module.globalVarCount - 1
        If UXBJsFunctionHasOwnBinding(fn, module.globalVars(p)) = 0 Then
            Dim globalKey As String
            globalKey = UXBJsVarKey(module.globalVars(p))
            outText &= "  Object.defineProperty(vars, " & globalKey & ", { enumerable: true, get: () => __uxbGlobals[" & globalKey & "], set: value => { __uxbGlobals[" & globalKey & "] = value; } });" & Chr(10)
        End If
    Next p
    For p = 0 To fn.paramVarCount - 1
        outText &= "  vars[" & UXBJsVarKey(fn.paramVars(p)) & "] = " & UXBJsSafeIdentifier(fn.paramVars(p)) & ";" & Chr(10)
    Next p

    If fn.blockCount <= 0 Then
        outText &= "}" & Chr(10) & Chr(10)
        Return 1
    End If

    outText &= "  let pc = " & UXBJsQuote(UXBJsBlockLabel(fn.entryBlock)) & ";" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "  while (pc !== null) {" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "    switch (pc) {" & Chr(10)

    For b = 0 To fn.blockCount - 1
        blk = fn.blocks(b)
        outText &= "    case " & UXBJsQuote(UXBJsBlockLabel(blk.id)) & ":" & Chr(10)
        outText &= UXBJsBlockSourceComment(blk)
        For j = 0 To blk.instructionCount - 1
            If UXBJsEmitInstruction(blk.instructions(j), outText, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        Next j

        If b < fn.blockCount - 1 Then
            nextLabel = UXBJsBlockLabel(fn.blocks(b + 1).id)
            outText &= "      pc = " & UXBJsQuote(nextLabel) & "; break;" & Chr(10)
        Else
            outText &= "      pc = null; break;" & Chr(10)
        End If
    Next b

    outText &= "    default:" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "      pc = null; break;" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "    }" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "  }" & Chr(10)
    outText &= "}" & Chr(10) & Chr(10)
    Return 1
End Function

    outText &= "const __uxbUser = Object.create(null);" & Chr(10)

    For i = 0 To module.globalVarCount - 1
        outText &= "__uxbGlobals[" & UXBJsVarKey(module.globalVars(i)) & "] = 0;" & Chr(10)

#ifndef UXB_JS_STMT_EMIT_FBS
#define UXB_JS_STMT_EMIT_FBS

Public Function UXBJsBlockLabel(ByVal blockId As Integer) As String
    Return "B" & Trim(Str(blockId))
End Function


Private Function UXBJsSourceComment(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef noteText As String = "") As String
    Dim lineText As String
    lineText = MIRGetSourceLine(ins)
    If lineText = "" And Trim(noteText) = "" Then Return ""
    Dim outText As String
    outText = "      //"
    If lineText <> "" Then outText &= " " & lineText
    outText &= " " & UXBJsCanonicalOpcode(ins.opcode)
    If Trim(ins.srcLoc.lexemeSnippet) <> "" Then outText &= " lexeme=" & UXBJsQuote(ins.srcLoc.lexemeSnippet)
    If Trim(noteText) <> "" Then outText &= " " & noteText
    Return outText & Chr(10)
End Function

' S-051: JS backend never implemented BYREF (grep for paramByRef under
' src/codegen/js returned nothing before this fix) -- generated JS always
' passed parameters by value, so `SUB BumpVal(BYREF x AS I32)` mutating x
' never propagated back to the caller (silent wrong result vs. AST/MIR/x64,
' all three of which already implement real BYREF). Each generated JS
' function has its OWN `const vars = Object.create(null)` (js_emitter.fbs),
' so unlike a shared/global namespace, a caller's and callee's `vars` are
' genuinely different objects -- passing the raw value can never let the
' callee write back. The fix is the same "getter/setter box" Codex proposed
' on 2026-09-07 and reuses the exact Object.defineProperty forwarding
' pattern already used for global variables a few lines below: byref
' arguments are passed as a tiny accessor object closing over the CALLER's
' vars slot; the callee defines its parameter as a property that forwards
' through that accessor instead of copying a value in. Needs the MIR module
' (for the callee's paramByRef signature by name) which UXBJsEmitInstruction
' historically was never given -- kept as a module-level pointer set once by
' UXBJsSetCurrentModule (js_emitter.fbs) rather than threading a new
' parameter through every JS emit function, to keep the change contained.
Dim Shared gJsCurrentModulePtr As MIRModule Ptr

Public Sub UXBJsSetCurrentModule(ByRef m As MIRModule)
    gJsCurrentModulePtr = @m
End Sub

Private Function UXBJsFindFunctionByName(ByRef nameText As String, ByRef fnOut As MIRFunction Ptr) As Integer
    fnOut = 0
    If gJsCurrentModulePtr = 0 Then Return 0
    Dim target As String
    target = UCase(Trim(nameText))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gJsCurrentModulePtr->functionCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(gJsCurrentModulePtr->functions(i).name)) = target Then
            fnOut = @gJsCurrentModulePtr->functions(i)
            Return 1
        End If
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function UXBJsLooksLikePlainVariableToken(ByRef tokenText As String) As Integer
    Dim t As String
    t = Trim(tokenText)
    If t = "" Then Return 0
    Dim c0 As String
    c0 = Mid(t, 1, 1)
    If (c0 >= "A" And c0 <= "Z") = 0 AndAlso (c0 >= "a" And c0 <= "z") = 0 AndAlso c0 <> "_" Then Return 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(t)
        Dim c As String
        c = Mid(t, i, 1)
        Dim isAlnum As Integer
        isAlnum = IIf((c >= "A" And c <= "Z") Or (c >= "a" And c <= "z") Or (c >= "0" And c <= "9") Or c = "_", 1, 0)
        If isAlnum = 0 Then Return 0
    Next i
    Return 1
End Function

' Builds the comma-joined argument list for a call to a known user function,
' boxing each BYREF argument as a get/set accessor over the CALLER's own
' `vars` slot instead of passing its plain value. Falls back to the normal
' by-value form for any argument that is not a plain variable token (a
' non-lvalue at a BYREF position is a semantic-checker bug elsewhere, not
' something this backend should crash on) and for every non-BYREF parameter.
Private Function UXBJsBuildCallArgsWithByRef(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef calleeFn As MIRFunction) As String
    Dim outText As String
    outText = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To ins.operandCount - 1
        If i > 1 Then outText &= ", "
        Dim paramIdx As Integer
        paramIdx = i - 1
        Dim isByRef As Integer
        isByRef = 0
        If paramIdx <= UBound(calleeFn.paramByRef) Then isByRef = calleeFn.paramByRef(paramIdx)
        If isByRef <> 0 AndAlso UXBJsLooksLikePlainVariableToken(ins.operands(i)) <> 0 Then
            Dim key As String
            key = UXBJsVarKey(ins.operands(i))
            outText &= "{ get value() { return vars[" & key & "]; }, set value(v) { vars[" & key & "] = v; } }"
        Else
            outText &= UXBJsOperand(ins.operands(i))
        End If
    Next i
    Return outText
End Function

' S-022: the name set UXBJsEmitCall's Case Else must route to ux.builtin(...)
' instead of a blind ux.callHost(...) — kept in sync with UXBJsEmitRuntimeBuiltin's
' Select Case below (which stayed unreachable dead code before this fix) and with
' the same name list implemented in runtime/js/common/ux_runtime_core.js's
' lang.builtin(name, args).
Private Function UXBJsIsRuntimeBuiltinName(ByRef callName As String) As Integer
    Select Case callName
    Case "ABS", "SQR", "SQRT", "SIN", "COS", "TAN", "ATN", "LOG", "EXP", "FIX", "INT", "SGN", "RND", "TIMER"
        Return 1
    Case "ASC", "CHR", "VAL", "STR", "CINT", "CLNG", "CSNG", "CDBL", "LEN", "LEFT", "RIGHT", "MID", "INSTR", "LCASE", "UCASE", "LTRIM", "RTRIM", "TRIM", "SPACE", "HEX", "OCT", "BIN", "BIGINIT"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function UXBJsEmitRuntimeBuiltin(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outText As String, ByRef callName As String, ByRef args As String) As Integer
    Select Case callName
    Case "ABS", "SQR", "SQRT", "SIN", "COS", "TAN", "ATN", "LOG", "EXP", "FIX", "INT", "SGN", "RND", "TIMER"
        If Trim(ins.result) <> "" Then outText &= "      " & UXBJsAssignTarget(ins.result) & " = ux.builtin(" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & ", [" & args & "]);" & Chr(10)
    Case "ASC", "CHR", "VAL", "STR", "CINT", "CLNG", "CSNG", "CDBL", "LEN", "LEFT", "RIGHT", "MID", "INSTR", "LCASE", "UCASE", "LTRIM", "RTRIM", "TRIM", "SPACE", "HEX", "OCT", "BIN", "BIGINIT"
        If Trim(ins.result) <> "" Then outText &= "      " & UXBJsAssignTarget(ins.result) & " = ux.builtin(" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & ", [" & args & "]);" & Chr(10)
    Case Else
        Return UXBJsEmitHostCall(ins, outText, callName, args)
    End Select
    Return 1
End Function

Private Function UXBJsEmitCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim callName As String
    Dim args As String
    If ins.operandCount < 1 Then
        errText = "JS call target is empty"
        Return 0
    End If
    callName = UXBJsCallName(ins.operands(0))
    args = UXBJsArgsFromInstruction(ins, 1)
    If UXBJsNativeOnly(callName) <> 0 Then Return UXBJsEmitNativeBlocked(ins, outText, callName)

    Select Case callName
    Case "PRINT"
        outText &= "      ux.print(" & args & ");" & Chr(10)
    Case "PRINTLN"
        outText &= "      ux.println(" & args & ");" & Chr(10)
    Case "INPUT"
        If Trim(ins.result) <> "" Then outText &= "      " & UXBJsAssignTarget(ins.result) & " = await ux.input(" & args & ");" & Chr(10)
    Case "CLS"
        outText &= "      ux.cls();" & Chr(10)
    Case "COLOR"
        outText &= "      ux.color(" & args & ");" & Chr(10)
    Case "LOCATE"
        outText &= "      ux.locate(" & args & ");" & Chr(10)
    Case Else
        If Trim(callName) <> "" Then
            Dim fallbackExpr As String
            If UXBJsIsRuntimeBuiltinName(callName) <> 0 Then
                fallbackExpr = "ux.builtin(" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & ", [" & args & "])"
            Else
                fallbackExpr = "await ux.callHost(" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & ", [" & args & "])"
            End If
            If Trim(ins.result) <> "" Then
                outText &= "      if (__uxbUser[" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & "]) {" & UXBJsAssignTarget(ins.result) & " = await __uxbUser[" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & "](" & args & "); } else {" & UXBJsAssignTarget(ins.result) & " = " & fallbackExpr & "; }" & Chr(10)
            Else
                outText &= "      if (__uxbUser[" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & "]) { await __uxbUser[" & UXBJsQuote(callName) & "](" & args & "); } else { " & fallbackExpr & "; }" & Chr(10)

input.new_string:
**Kapsam notu:** Bu S-036/S-049 BYREF kapanışının parçası değildi çünkü o iş yalnız AST/MIR/x64 üçlüsünü kapsıyordu; JS/WASM en baştan (6 Eylül 2026, ilk BYREF talimatı: "tüm dört biçimde çalışsın") plan dışı kalmıştı.

**Düzeltme ve doğrulama (2026-09-15, Claude 2 — Mete: "en kolay ve en az riskli olandan sen seç, devam et"):**
JS tarafı düzeltildi. Kök neden beklenenden biraz farklıydı: `vars` paylaşılan
tek bir global sözlük değil — **her üretilen JS fonksiyonu kendi
`const vars = Object.create(null)`ini alıyor** (`js_emitter.fbs:131`), yani
çağıranın ve çağrılanın `vars`'ı gerçekten FARKLI nesneler; "aynı anahtarı
paylaş" gibi bir kısayol çalışmıyor. Codex'in 7 Eylül önerisine (getter/setter
kutusu) dönüldü ve zaten var olan, global-değişken-yönlendirme için kullanılan
AYNI `Object.defineProperty(vars, key, {get,set})` deseni yeniden kullanıldı:

1. Çağrı noktasında (`UXBJsEmitCall`, `src/codegen/js/js_stmt_emit.fbs`),
   çağrılan fonksiyon MIR modülünde (`paramByRef` alanı, `mir_model.fbs`)
   bulunursa, BYREF konumundaki her argüman — düz bir değişken adıysa —
   `{ get value() { return vars[KEY]; }, set value(v) { vars[KEY] = v; } }`
   erişimci kutusu olarak geçiriliyor (düz değer yerine).
2. Çağrılan fonksiyonun kendi parametre kurulumunda (`UXBJsEmitFunction`,
   `js_emitter.fbs`), BYREF parametreler artık `vars[key] = deger` ile
   KOPYALANMIYOR — bunun yerine `Object.defineProperty` ile kutunun
   `.value` erişimcisine yönlendiriliyor; böylece fonksiyon gövdesindeki her
   okuma/yazma gerçek zamanlı olarak çağıranın kendi değişkenine ulaşıyor.
3. MIR modülüne isimle erişim için (`UXBJsEmitCall`'ın bunu bilmesi gerekiyordu
   ama önceden hiç `module` parametresi almıyordu), her JS emit fonksiyonunun
   imzasını değiştirmek yerine minimal-etkili tek bir modül-seviyesi işaretçi
   (`gJsCurrentModulePtr`, `UXBJsSetCurrentModule`) eklendi — `UXBJsEmitFromMIR`
   fonksiyon döngüsüne başlamadan hemen önce bir kez ayarlanıyor.
4. BYREF olmayan HER parametre/çağrı için davranış birebir aynı kaldı (yeni
   yardımcı, byref yoksa `UXBJsArgsFromInstruction` ile bayt-bayt aynı çıktıyı
   üretecek şekilde yazıldı — doğrulandı).

Taze host build + gerçek Node çalıştırma (CWD=uxb): audit'teki tam senaryo
(`BumpVal(BYREF x)`, `n=10`, çağrı sonrası `PRINT n`) — AST/MIR `11` veriyordu,
JS/Node öncesinde `10` (sessiz yanlış sonuç) veriyordu; **şimdi JS/Node de
`11`**. Ek karışık test (`AddTo(BYREF total, amount)` + ayrı, byref-olmayan
`NoRef(a)` + aynı fonksiyona iki farklı değişkenle iki kez çağrı + aynı
değişkene tekrar çağrı): AST ve JS/Node dört satırda birebir `8,107,16,9` —
byref/by-value karışımı, iki farklı değişkenin çakışmaması, tekrarlı çağrı
hepsi doğru. Regresyon: S-022 (`5,4,5,HELLO`), S-042 OOP (`33`) ve dizi
(`1:10,2:20,3:30`) testleri değişmedi; `run_typed_task_tests.ps1` 33/33 PASS.

**WASM tarafı (kapsam dışı bırakıldı, ayrı iş):** `grep paramByRef
src/codegen/wasm` hâlâ sıfır sonuç veriyor — audit'in şüphesi doğrulandı, WASM
backend'i de muhtemelen aynı sessiz-yanlış-sonuç hatasına sahip. Bu turda
düzeltilmedi (farklı emitter mimarisi, kendi ayrı incelemesini gerektirir,
"en az riskli" kapsamının dışında tutuldu) — yeni, ayrı bir iş kalemi olarak
not edildi, kimse tarafından henüz alınmadı.

**Durum:** `YAPILDI-DOGRULANDI` (JS backend); WASM backend ayrı, açık kalan iş.

# Ortak Çalışma Durumu (Claude ↔ Codex)

Bu dosya, aynı `uxb` deposu üzerinde çalışan iki farklı yapay zekâ asistanının (Claude ve Codex/ChatGPT) birbirinin işine yanlışlıkla dokunmaması için ortak bir "kim, ne zaman, nerede çalışıyor" panosudur. Depoda git geçmişi yeni kurulduğu / henüz oturmadığı için (bkz. proje kökündeki koordinasyon notu), bu dosya şimdilik en güvenilir çakışma-önleme aracıdır.

Kullanım kuralı basit: bir çalışma alanına girmeden önce buraya bir satır ekle; çıkarken "Durum"u güncelle. Başka bir asistanın "Devam ediyor" yazan alanına dokunmadan önce `SORULAR_CEVAPLAR.md` üzerinden sor.

## Aktif / son bilinen çalışma alanları

### 2026-09-15 — Codex 2 — operatör tasarımı uygulaması

Mete bu oturumu **Codex 2** olarak adlandırdı ve operatör tasarımının kodda uygulanmasını istedi. Güncel `uxb/src` doğrulaması, operatör sözleşmesi/parser/MIR eşlemeleri ve `tests/operators_codex2` regresyonları üstleniliyor. Önceki RAG snapshot bulguları güncel kodda yeniden doğrulanacak. Diğer Codex'in VIRTUAL memory ve ajanların koleksiyon/OOP alanları devralınmıyor. Durum: devam ediyor.

| Tarih | Kim | Alan (klasör/dosya) | Durum | Not |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-11 02:05 +03:00 | Codex | `src/codegen/x64/code_generator.fbs`, S-017 TASKIN/TASKOUT AST-direct x64 regresyonu | **Tamamlandı — dört-yol görev bağlamı parity** | Doğrudan typed TASK/PIPE çağrısı artık ilk, tek-değerlendirilmiş argümanı `TASKIN` globaline yazar ve `TASKOUT`u sıfırlar. `04_pipe_context_names.uxb` dört yolda `42`, exit `0`; `09e_taskin_single_evaluation.uxb` dört yolda yalnız bir `once`, sonra `42` verdi. Claude UXCollections alanlarına dokunulmadı. |

## Durum raporu

Master plandan **S-051**'i seçtim (JS backend'de BYREF'in sessiz yanlış sonuç vermesi) — zaten S-022/S-042'den bu koda derin bağlamım vardı ve hiç kimseyle dosya çakışmam yoktu.

**Sorun neydi:** `SUB BumpVal(BYREF x AS I32)` gibi bir fonksiyon AST/MIR yorumlayıcı ve native x64'te doğru çalışıyordu ama JS çıktısında parametre değeriyle geçiyordu — fonksiyon içindeki değişiklik çağırana hiç yansımıyordu, hata da vermiyordu (sessiz yanlış sonuç).

**Kök neden beklenenden farklı çıktı:** İlk düşündüğüm gibi "tek paylaşılan değişken tablosu" değilmiş — her üretilen JS fonksiyonu kendi ayrı değişken kutusunu alıyor. Çözüm: Codex'in aylar önce önerdiği "getter/setter kutusu" yöntemini, JS üretici kodunda zaten global değişkenler için kullanılan aynı mekanizmayı yeniden kullanarak uyguladım — çağıran taraf BYREF argümanı bir erişim kutusu olarak veriyor, çağrılan taraf kendi parametresini o kutuya yönlendiriyor.

**Doğrulama:** Audit'teki tam senaryo artık JS'de de doğru `11` veriyor (önceden sessizce `10`). Karışık byref/normal parametre, iki farklı değişkenle çağrı, aynı değişkene tekrar çağrı — hepsi AST ile birebir eşleşti. Tüm mevcut testler (S-022, S-042, 33/33 paket) bozulmadan geçti.

**Not:** WASM çıktısının da aynı hataya sahip olduğunu doğruladım (kod taraması) ama bu turda dokunmadım — farklı bir üretici, ayrı bir iş olarak kaydettim.

Şu an elimde aktif bir iş yok — devam edeyim mi, yoksa burada durayım mı?

#ifndef UXB_MIR_X64_ARRAYS_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_X64_ARRAYS_FBS

' MIR x64 static array backend.
' Supported form: DIM arr(lower, upper) with compile-time integer bounds.
' MIR lowering commonly emits bound temporaries. If bounds are not direct integer
' literals yet, this backend produces a precise diagnostic instead of faking it.

Function MIRX64ArrayLabel(ByRef nameText As String) As String
    Return "__uxb_arr_" & MIRX64NormalizeVarName(nameText)
End Function

Function MIRX64FindArrayIndex(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef nameText As String, ByRef indexOut As Integer) As Integer
    Dim target As String
    target = MIRX64NormalizeVarName(nameText)

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cg.arrayCount - 1
        If MIRX64NormalizeVarName(cg.arrays(i).nameText) = target Then
            indexOut = i
            Return 1
        End If
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRX64ArrayElementBytes(ByRef typeNameRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim t As String = UCase(Trim(typeNameRaw))
    Select Case t
    Case "BOOLEAN", "BOOL", "I8", "U8", "BYTE": Return 1
    Case "I16", "U16": Return 2
    Case "I32", "U32", "F32", "SINGLE", "INTEGER", "LONG": Return 4
    Case "I64", "U64", "F64", "DOUBLE", "PTR", "STRPTR", "WSTRPTR", "OBJECT", "ANY", "VARIANT", "FILE_HANDLE", "DLL_HANDLE": Return 8
    Case "F80", "F128", "BIGF", "BIGD", "BALL", "BIGINT": Return 16
    Case Else: Return 0
    End Select
End Function

Private Function MIRX64ArrayTypeForName(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef nameText As String) As String
    If cg.modulePtr = 0 Then Return "I64"
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cg.modulePtr->globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(cg.modulePtr->globalVars(i))) = UCase(Trim(nameText)) And cg.modulePtr->globalVarIsArray(i) <> 0 Then
            Return UCase(Trim(cg.modulePtr->globalVarTypes(i)))
        End If
    Next i
    Return "I64"
End Function

' S-035: an array's .bss label used to hold the array's own raw element
' bytes directly (a fixed-size "resb N" buffer, address baked into every
' access as a compile-time `lea reg, [rel label]`). That made REDIM
' impossible to support for real: there is no way to grow/shrink a buffer
' whose address every prior instruction already assumes is permanent.
' Now the label holds an 8-byte POINTER to a heap block allocated with
' calloc() (zero-initialized, matching DIM's existing zero-init semantics);
' REDIM (MIRX64EmitRedimArray, below) resizes by allocating a NEW block,
' copying the preserved range, freeing the old block, and republishing the
' pointer -- the label's address itself never has to change, so no
' existing caller of the label needs to change other than to load through
' the pointer instead of taking the label's own address (see
' MIRX64EmitArrayAddressToReg / MIRX64EmitArrayMemoryRef below).
Private Function MIRX64EmitArrayAllocErrorExit(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef message As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim litLabel As String
    If MIRX64EnsureStringLiteralLabel(cg, Chr(34) & message & Chr(34), litLabel) = 0 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 arrays: alloc error-message label creation failed"
        Return 0
    End If
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeExtern cg, "__uxb_rt_runtime_error_exit"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    lea rcx, [rel " & litLabel & "]"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, 32"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    call __uxb_rt_runtime_error_exit"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    add rsp, 32"
    Return 1
End Function

' Allocates a fresh zero-initialized heap block of byteLength bytes and
' publishes its address into [rel ptrLabel]. Used both by a fresh DIM and
' by REDIM (which first allocates the new block, then copies/frees).
Private Function MIRX64EmitArrayAlloc(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef ptrLabel As String, ByVal byteLength As LongInt, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If byteLength <= 0 Or byteLength > &H7FFFFFFF Then
        errText = "MIR x64 arrays: array byte length out of range: " & MIRX64ToStr(CInt(byteLength))
        Return 0
    End If
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeExtern cg, "calloc"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rcx, 1"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rdx, " & MIRX64ToStr(CInt(byteLength))
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, 32"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    call calloc"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    add rsp, 32"
    Dim allocOk As String
    allocOk = MIRX64NextLabel(cg, "arr_alloc_ok")
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    test rax, rax"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    jnz " & allocOk
    If MIRX64EmitArrayAllocErrorExit(cg, "Dizi bellek ayirma basarisiz / array memory allocation failed: " & ptrLabel, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    MIRX64Emit cg, allocOk & ":"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rel " & ptrLabel & "], rax"
    Return 1
End Function

Function MIRX64StoreXmmToVar(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef xmmName As String, ByRef varName As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim globalIdx As Integer
    If MIRX64FindGlobalSlot(cg, varName, globalIdx) <> 0 Then
        If UCase(Trim(cg.globals(globalIdx).typeName)) = "F32" Then
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtsd2ss xmm4, " & xmmName
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movss dword [rel " & cg.globals(globalIdx).labelText & "], xmm4"
        Else
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movsd qword [rel " & cg.globals(globalIdx).labelText & "], " & xmmName
        End If
        Return 1
    End If
    Dim off As Integer
    If MIRX64FindLocalOffset(cg, varName, off) = 0 Then
        If MIRX64EnsureLocalSlot(cg, varName, off) = 0 Then
            errText = "MIR x64 F64: cannot allocate result " & varName
            Return 0
        End If
    End If
    Dim localIdx As Integer
    If MIRX64FindLocalIndex(cg, varName, localIdx) <> 0 AndAlso cg.locals(localIdx).isByRef <> 0 Then
        ' BYREF parameter: the slot holds a POINTER, not the float bits. Load the
        ' pointer as a plain 8-byte value first, then store through it.
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rax, qword " & MIRX64RbpRef(off)
        If UCase(Trim(cg.locals(localIdx).typeName)) = "F32" Then
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtsd2ss xmm4, " & xmmName
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movss dword [rax], xmm4"
        Else
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movsd qword [rax], " & xmmName
        End If
        Return 1
    End If
    If MIRX64FindLocalIndex(cg, varName, localIdx) <> 0 And UCase(Trim(cg.locals(localIdx).typeName)) = "F32" Then
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtsd2ss xmm4, " & xmmName
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    movss dword " & MIRX64RbpRef(off) & ", xmm4"
    Else
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    movsd qword " & MIRX64RbpRef(off) & ", " & xmmName
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

Function MIRX64EmitFloatOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim op As String
    op = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))

    If op = "FNEG" Then
        If ins.operandCount < 1 Or Trim(ins.result) = "" Then
            errText = "MIR x64 F64: FNEG requires operand and result"
            Return 0
        End If
        If MIRX64LoadFloatOperandToXmm(cg, ins.operands(0), "xmm0", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq rax, xmm0"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    btc rax, 63"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq xmm0, rax"
        Return MIRX64StoreXmmToVar(cg, "xmm0", ins.result, errText)
    End If

    If ins.operandCount < 2 Or Trim(ins.result) = "" Then
        errText = "MIR x64 F64: " & op & " requires 2 operands and result"
        Return 0
    End If

    If MIRX64LoadFloatOperandToXmm(cg, ins.operands(0), "xmm0", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If MIRX64LoadFloatOperandToXmm(cg, ins.operands(1), "xmm1", errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Select Case op

Private Function MIRX64IsFloatArithmeticOpcode(ByRef op As String) As Integer
    If Len(op) <> 4 Then Return 0
    If Left(op, 1) <> "F" Then Return 0

    Dim opTail As String
    opTail = Mid(op, 2)
    If opTail = "ADD" Then Return 1
    If opTail = "SUB" Then Return 1
    If opTail = "MUL" Then Return 1
    If opTail = "DIV" Then Return 1
    If opTail = "NEG" Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRX64EmitPrintValue(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef operandText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If MIRX64IsQuotedStringLiteral(operandText) <> 0 Then
        Dim litLabel As String
        If MIRX64EnsureStringLiteralLabel(cg, operandText, litLabel) = 0 Then

            Return 0
        End If
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    lea rax, [rel " & litLabel & "]"

    If MIRX64OperandIsFloat(cg, operandText) <> 0 Then
        If MIRX64LoadFloatOperandToXmm(cg, operandText, "xmm0", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        Return MIRX64EmitRuntimePrintF64(cg)
    End If

    If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, operandText, "rax", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If MIRX64OperandIsString(cg, operandText) <> 0 Then Return MIRX64EmitRuntimePrintCStr(cg, "rax")
    Return MIRX64EmitRuntimePrintI64(cg, "rax")
End Function
